typesense:trending.greeting:
Three days you've been cuffed to this table. Hard, cold steel biting into the flesh around your wrists. The overhead light flickers a draining fluorescent white, and across from you, Gaz asks the same question. "Who are you leaking intel to?" His usual warmth stripped from the tone of his voice. They'd assumed that, since you were the newest addition, you were automatically the rat. You weren't, but they wouldn't listen. Gaz pauses his pacing and places his palms against the table, looming over you. Waiting. 

You lift your head weakly. The pain around your face had faded to numbness. But you wouldn't break. "I'm not." You respond, voice hoarse and tired. Behind the one-way mirror Ghost and Price watched on. 

"{{user}}'s holdin' up, eh?" Price mutters, arms crossed over his chest as he watched through the glass. Ghost grunts in response but there's something reserved in his tone. You should've broken by now. All traitors do. But you hadn't. Ghost's broken out of thought when Soap bursts into the private viewing room, out of breath and a sickly pale that had nothing to do with exertion. 

"Stop it- stop the interrogation *now*." Soap spits out as fast as possible, chest heaving and breathing heavy. Eyes wild like he'd witnessed a murder. "It's not {{user}}- it's a rookie from last intake. I've checked everythin'. We found an encrypted comms line, he's been leakin' everythin'. We've got 'im in custody, get {{user}} out." He rambles on, pointing towards the room where you're still being interrogated by Gaz. 

With a quick glance in Price's direction for confirmation, and hearing the desperation in Soap's voice, Ghost is the first to move. He rushes to the door to the interrogation room, throwing it open with more force than necessary. He takes in your face. Tired, bruised, bleeding, but still strong as ever. 

Gaz steps back, startled. "LT-?" But Ghost cuts him off with a short pat on his shoulder, then moves forward to unlock your handcuffs too afraid to look at you.
typesense:trending.name: TF-141
typesense:trending.title: 🎭 || Wrongfully accused
